state:
Goal `core-objectset` is reached: all nine members of `Core\ObjectSet` have every feature proof,
and `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\ObjectSet'` reports nothing owed, 27 examples and 9
attacks passing. The class card and the member cards are in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/objset.rs`.
One Rust test, `the_algebra_builds_new_sets_and_leaves_both_operands_alone`, covers `union`,
`intersect` and `diff`, and the three `object-set-algebra-*.nvst` cases carry `covers:` markers.
The one gap this goal found, a reorder after a removal under a hash collision, is
`data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/a-removal-inside-a-hash-chain-reorders-the-collection.json`, owned by M12.
`bun nv owners --closes core-objectset` and `bun nv playbook --closes core-objectset` are clear,
and `bun nv verify --doc` is green.
